answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 31750 Country: India Title: Can we make dua other than Allah ? I seen some people make dua with the help of a pir like nizam uddin . Question: Can we make dua other than Allah ? I seen some people make dua with the help of a pir like nizam uddin . some people make their dua inthe sadka of this pir ? if it is wrong the please answer me with qurqn and hadith hawalla. Answer ID: 31750 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 859/859/M=1432) It is not lawful to supplicate anyone except Allah. It is against the teachings of the holy Quran: وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهاً آخَرَ [القصص : 88] However, it is right to supplicate with the waseelah (intermediation) of Prophets (عليهم السلام) and Awliya (رحمهم الله). There is a hadith in Bukhari regarding supplication with the waseelah (intermediation) of Hadhrat Abbas (رضى الله عنه). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
